items.title: Uber (UBER) Launches First Europe AV Rides And Driverless Dubai Fleet
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) is rolling out new autonomous services, including its first European AV rides in Zagreb through partnerships with Verne and Pony.ai. In Dubai, Uber is introducing fully driverless rides using Baidu’s Apollo Go technology as part of a new fleet partnership. Uber is also teaming up with Zoomcar in India to integrate self-drive and chauffeur-driven options for domestic travelers.
